summary: Continuation: the earlier run already built the icon layer on this branch (UI/zestIcons.tsx, UI/ZestIcon.tsx, 47 entries in semanticTypeButtonConfigDefaults.tsx, ZestIcon exports in UI/index.ts, .zestIcon CSS, package.json at 1.7.0, docs mentioning ZestIcon, and tests ZestIcon/semanticTypeIcons/zestIconPerformance). Nothing is re-scaffolded or redesigned. This run verifies each requirement against the code and fixes only gaps. Design as built and kept: a module-level map of 47 SVG elements created once at import (aliases share an element), looked up in O(1); ZestIcon renders them aria-hidden and focusable=false, returns null for unknown names, and applies size/className without cloning the shared element; built-in defaults use these elements as iconLeft (iconRight for view, details, next); the 28 new types follow R2 (approve success; reject and warning danger; back start, next end; send, login, logout, export, import, approve, reject, archive have minBusyDurationMs 500 only; none confirm); SemanticType covers 47 names; the existing useZestConfig precedence is untouched so an app's own registration wins over built-ins. Public surface: added ZestIcon, ZestIconProps, ZestIconSize and the widened SemanticType; nothing removed or renamed. Dependencies, peer dependencies, rollup config and dist layout are unchanged (react-icons stays for FaSpinner and the dropdown chevron); package.json stays at 1.7.0 with no further bump. Gap-closing work is limited to: (1) checks that every built-in type has an icon with the shared style, aria-hidden, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML/href/on* attributes, same element reference across re-renders, and the unchanged behaviour of the 19 old names; (2) a manual dist/index.esm.js size check (no more than 15 KB growth, no .size-limit.json exists, recorded in the review); (3) docs accuracy: every page lists 47 types, the icon-only aria-label guidance, the icon change in breaking-changes, how to add an icon in development, and prev/next links on each page; (4) fix any failing test or mismatch found. Cost: 47 small path strings and elements allocated once, constant per-button render work, no listeners, timers, network or storage; 100x more buttons only adds DOM nodes.

touches: UI/semanticTypeButtonConfigDefaults.tsx — only if verification finds a default that does not match R2 or an icon missing
UI/zestIcons.tsx — only to fix an icon that breaks the shared style or R4
UI/ZestIcon.tsx — only to fix a defect found
UI/ZestButton.tsx — only if SemanticType does not list all 47 names
UI/index.ts — only if the ZestIcon exports are incomplete
Styles/ZestButton.module.css — only for the .zestIcon rules if a defect is found
package.json and package-lock.json — only to confirm 1.7.0; no dependency change, no further bump
README.md and documentation/*.md — correct any claim that does not match the code, and complete prev/next links
Existing tests — extended for gaps found; behavioural expectations of the 19 old names are not weakened
reuses: The built icon registry, ZestIcon, the 47-entry defaults map and the useZestConfig precedence chain
Existing styles.icon slot and currentColor theming; the existing 24-unit SVG convention
react-icons/fa6 for the spinner and dropdown arrow (out of scope)
Existing Jest + React Testing Library setup, buildExternalization and packagePeerDependencies tests as guards
adds: Only missing tests or doc text that verification of R1-R8 shows is absent
A recorded manual bundle-size measurement in the review
